entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: Mercantile organization spanning several planes, procuring any items clients wanted.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who usurped the Consortium in a bloody coup and led it from the Iron Tower.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who worked for the Consortium and later crushed Tezzeret's mind.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker occasionally hired by the Consortium.

entities.name: Iron Tower
entities.description: Consortium headquarters in a desert region of an unknown plane.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Home of one of the Consortium's most important cells.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Home of a young cell opposed by the nezumi-bito.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: Event several years after Tezzeret's coup.

events.summary: Tezzeret usurps the Consortium from Nicol Bolas in a bloody coup d'etat.
events.quote: was usurped by Tezzeret in a bloody coup d'état

events.summary: Jace Beleren crushes Tezzeret's mind and destroys the information needed to run the Consortium, dissolving it.
Jace returns to the remnants of the Ravnican cell and assumes leadership.
events.quote: Jace could return to the remnants of the Ravnican cell and assume leadership of it

events.summary: Tezzeret's darksteel renews his memories, and he settles on the plane of his old headquarters.
events.quote: settled there to plot his next moves

relations.quote: The Consortium was founded by Nicol Bolas

relations.note: He led it after the coup.
Jace worked for the Consortium as one of its planeswalkers.
relations.quote: There were five planeswalkers working for the Consortium
